status: frozen 2026-11-21 on Juan PC (4 vCPU / 6 GiB VM); v5 matrix and route under the same data conditions
scope: Glance Python versus Glance Go under the same conditions: same Apache route, same MySQL server and glance database, same filesystem store and same Keystone service user (Go reads the original glance-api.conf), both with notifications noop. 9 loads x C=1/4/8/16 x 5 repetitions.
predecessor: glance-compact-v5 accepted 360/360 (Juan PC); v5 ran Go on its own MySQL server and store, and Go sent notifications while Python did not
acceptance: All 108 windows valid for this reduced scope; hashes, lengths, state, resource sampling, cleanup and original restoration verified; no minimum speedup required
purpose: Remove the remaining environment differences: the only difference left is the implementation
log_policy: Bound VM operational logs; rotate only outside measured windows, retain recent incident diagnostics and all benchmark samples
statistics: Five independent paired repetitions per cell; publish individual results, median and range; bootstrap confidence only as declared
reason: v5 limit: Go had a dedicated MySQL (128 MiB buffer pool, only its images) while Python shared DevStack MySQL (16 MiB, ~6000 tombstones). Go now uses the official catalog as in the permanent replacement. Python stays noop (stock messagingv2 exhausted descriptors in v2); Go is noop too so both do the same work.
timeout_reason: Pilot attempts 1 and 3 stopped at upload-64m C=16: a small metadata GET of the original waited 10.05 s behind 64 MiB uploads (2 uWSGI workers saturated, ~78 MiB/s for 16 clients) and hit the client 10 s timeout. 120 s, as for binary requests, records that wait as latency; requests over 10 s are counted per window (requests_over_10s). Any HTTP error, wrong bytes or failed cleanup still invalidates the window.
initial_state: Catalog purged before the campaign with the original tool: glance-manage db purge and purge_images_table, --age_in_days 0 (24157 soft-deleted images from earlier campaigns removed). Only the 2 active images remain (CirrOS, mi-cirros); Glance Go bookkeeping rows of purged images (74, phase cleaned) removed so its startup recovery has nothing orphaned.
